target.statement: PCA(2D) + K-Means (k=4) clustering achieves Silhouette ≈ 0.413461, CH ≈ 106.77, DB ≈ 0.797568 on the 113-gamer survey data
target.dataset: Custom survey of 113 self-identified gamers (from ~236-250 respondents), collected by authors

compute.basis: Pipeline is trivial (PCA + K-Means on ~113 rows, a few dozen features) and would run in seconds on a CPU; the only real cost is writing the preprocessing/encoding code, but the raw survey data is not available.

blockers: Survey data (113 gamers) is only available 'from the corresponding author upon reasonable request' — not publicly downloadable
No code or repository linked in the paper
Preprocessing details (feature consolidation, alias harmonization, category merging) are described only qualitatively, so exact feature matrix cannot be reconstructed
title: Unveiling Gamer Archetypes through Multi modal feature Correlations and Unsupervised Learning
